Proprietary cash flows from the Total column (p8; p7 is the Electric half). Cash: Total Governmental Funds Cash and cash equivalents 793,542 (p3); no prior-year balance sheet, so beginning cash null. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3; total assets 1,520,742 equals p1 governmental column), business-type lines from p1; component unit (Wauneta Care and Therapy Center) excluded. Statement of Activities: only the program-revenue half (p2) is in the trim; its general revenues/net position page is not. General Fund detail is from the budgetary comparison schedule (p9): the General Fund departments combining statement (p12) shows only the General, Fire and Park columns; its continuation page (Library, Community building, Cemetery, Total; report p52) is not in the trim, so the departmental schedule is not recorded (no double counting). Loan repayments budget line (budget 8,000, actual none) not recorded. Street Fund from its budget schedule (p10); nonmajor Keno, Sales Tax and Special funds from the combining statement (p11); utility funds (Electric, Water, Sewer, Apartments) from the proprietary statement fund columns (p6; no utility budget schedules in the trim).
